name: Soyuz T-10
about: Soyuz T-10 (1984-014A), a crewed vehicle (7K-ST), launched 1984 Feb  8. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1984 Mar  9), held fixed
docked to S13138; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
